shellCommands.command:
node server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
echo "PID=$SERVER_PID"
sleep 1
echo "--- log ---"
cat /tmp/server.log
echo "--- home ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -40
echo "--- add book ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/add \
  -d "title=The Hobbit&author=J.R.R. Tolkien&notes=Reading aloud to the kids."
echo "--- list ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "(Currently reading|Finished|book-title)" | head -10
echo "--- data file ---"
cat /workspace/data/books.json
echo "--- get id ---"
ID=$(node -e "const b=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/workspace/data/books.json','utf8'));console.log(b[0].id)")
echo "ID=$ID"
echo "--- detail ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/book/$ID" | grep -E "(The Hobbit|Tolkien|notes-box|Share)" | head -10
echo "--- finish ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3000/book/$ID/finish"
echo "--- detail after finish ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/book/$ID" | grep -E "(Finished on|book-title|share-link)" | head -5
echo "--- list after finish ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "(Currently reading|Finished.*\(|book-row)" | head -10
echo "--- 404 ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3000/book/does-not-exist"
echo "--- restart test ---"
kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
node server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "(The Hobbit|Finished.*\(1\))" | head -5
kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
echo "--- done ---"
